# Hirify

> > Hirify is a specialized IT and digital job board connecting tech talent with opportunities in AI, GameDev, SaaS, Web3, iGaming, and startups across remote and international locations.

Hirify aggregates tech positions requiring skills in cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform), programming languages (Python, TypeScript, Go), monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana), and digital marketing platforms (Google Analytics, Facebook Ads). The platform serves job seekers across multiple regions including Canada, United Kingdom, US, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Germany, and Japan.

## Key Topics

- Remote work and distributed teams
- iGaming and gaming industry careers
- Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform)
- Programming languages (Python, TypeScript, Go)
- DevOps and monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana)
- Digital marketing (Google Analytics, Facebook Ads, Google AdWords)
- AI and machine learning roles
- Web3 and blockchain opportunities
- SaaS product companies
- International tech recruitment
- Startup ecosystem jobs
- Tech career development
- Work-from-anywhere positions

## Main Job Boards

- [Your next dream job is here | Hirify](https://hirify.me/): IT & Digital job board for AI, GameDev, SaaS, Web3 & startup careers
- [Remote Jobs | Work From Anywhere | Hirify](https://hirify.me/remote-jobs): Remote job board with flexible positions across USA, Japan, Canada & UK
- [iGaming Jobs | Hirify](https://hirify.me/igaming-jobs): Browse iGaming job opportunities across Cyprus, US, Bulgaria & Germany
